001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api;
002
003import lombok.Getter;
004import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
005
006import java.util.Arrays;
007
008/**
009 * Utilities to help QuickShop quickly check server supported features
010 *
011 * @author Ghost_chu and sandtechnology
012 */
013@Getter
014public enum GameVersion {
015  v1_18_R1(new String[]{ "1.18", "1.18.1" }, false, true, false, true, false),
016  v1_18_R2(new String[]{ "1.18.2" }, true, true, true, true, false),
017  v1_19_R1(new String[]{ "1.19", "1.19.1" }, true, true, true, true, false),
018  v1_19_R2(new String[]{ "1.19.2" }, true, true, true, true, false),
019  v1_19_R3(new String[]{ "1.19.3", "1.19.4" }, true, true, true, true, false),
020  v1_20_R1(new String[]{ "1.20", "1.20.1" }, true, true, true, true, false),
021  v1_20_R2(new String[]{ "1.20.2", "1.20.3" }, true, true, true, true, false),
022  v1_20_R3(new String[]{ "1.20.4", "1.20.5" }, true, true, true, true, true),
023  v1_20_R4(new String[]{ "1.20.6" }, true, true, true, true, true),
024  v1_21_R1(new String[]{ "1.21", "1.21.1" }, true, false, true, true, true),
025  v1_21_R2(new String[]{ "1.21.2", "1.21.3" }, true, false, true, true, true),
026  v1_21_R3(new String[]{ "1.21.4" }, true, false, true, true, true),
027  v1_21_R4(new String[]{ "1.21.5" }, true, false, true, true, true),
028  v1_21_R5(new String[]{ "1.21.6" }, true, false, true, true, true),
029  v1_21_R6(new String[]{ "1.21.7", "1.21.8", "1.21.9" }, true, false, true, true, true),
030  v1_21_R9(new String[]{ "1.21.10" }, true, false, true, true, true),
031  v1_21_R10(new String[]{ "1.21.11" }, true, false, true, true, true),
032  UNKNOWN(new String[0], true, false, false, true, true);
033  private final String[] mcVersion;
034  /**
035   * CoreSupports - Check does QuickShop most features supports this server version
036   */
037  private final boolean coreSupports;
038
039  /**
040   * EndOfLife - It will disable update checker or some else checks
041   */
042  private final boolean endOfLife;
043
044  /**
045   * VirtualDisplaySupports - Check does QuickShop VirtualDisplayItem feature this server version
046   */
047  private final boolean virtualDisplaySupports;
048
049  /**
050   * NewNmsName - Use 1.17+ nms class name mapping
051   */
052  private final boolean newNmsName;
053
054  private final boolean newPotionAPI;
055
056  GameVersion(final String[] mcVersion, final boolean coreSupports, final boolean endOfLife, final boolean virtualDisplaySupports, final boolean newNmsName, final boolean newPotionAPI) {
057
058    this.mcVersion = mcVersion;
059    this.coreSupports = coreSupports;
060    this.endOfLife = endOfLife;
061    this.virtualDisplaySupports = virtualDisplaySupports;
062    this.newNmsName = newNmsName;
063    this.newPotionAPI = newPotionAPI;
064  }
065
066
067  /**
068   * Matches the version that QuickShop supports or not
069   *
070   * @param nmsVersion The Minecraft NMS version
071   *
072   * @return The object contains supports details for GameVersion
073   */
074  @NotNull
075  public static GameVersion get(@NotNull final String nmsVersion) {
076
077    for(final GameVersion version : GameVersion.values()) {
078      if(version.name().equals(nmsVersion)) {
079        return version;
080      }
081      if(Arrays.asList(version.mcVersion).contains(nmsVersion)) {
082        return version;
083      }
084    }
085    return v1_21_R10;
086  }
087
088}
